broken-behavior/custom-github-egress-sur.subject: custom-github-egress-surrogate
broken-behavior/custom-github-egress-sur.summary: custom.github connector egress proxy forwards literal Bearer hsurr:* surrogate instead of substituting stored credential, causing GitHub API 401
broken-behavior/custom-github-egress-sur.context: User set up custom.github connector via credentials.request_api_access with api_hosts=[api.github.com], placement=bearer_header. Credential stored successfully, surrogate retrievable via authdc. Requests to api.github.com traverse egress proxy but arrive at GitHub with literal Bearer hsurr:* instead of the stored PAT, causing HTTP 401 Bad credentials. custom.x connector uses identical surrogate mechanism successfully, proving vault and general egress work. Required fix: repair/enable egress surrogate substitution binding for custom.github to api.github.com. Do not regenerate PAT.
